title: feat(desktop): record modes UI — selector chrome, region countdown and Record page
body:
Task 5 of [Record capture modes](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/blob/feat/record-modes-ui/apps/documentation/src/content/docs/specs/2026-10-26-record-capture-modes-design.md) (NIW2-513): the visible layer, built from the Claude Design file "Kaipu Record Modes". The engine side shipped in #377.

## What changed

**Selector (capture overlay, `record` intent)**
- Frame box: ratio bar above it (Free · 16:9 · 9:16 · 1:1, plus the live size in device pixels from a new `&scale=` query param written only for this intent); a vertical widget on its right (Capture | Record switch, modes 1–n, Mic / System audio / Camera, Cancel); a pink "● Start recording ↵" pill under it; a camera placeholder where the bubble will be anchored while the camera is on; 32 % dim outside.
- Locked ratios constrain drawing a new box, corner drags (the opposite corner stays) and edge drags (the box grows around its centre line). A ratio chip reshapes the box around its centre. The ratio is remembered with the area per display (`RememberedArea.ratio` in `AppSettings.recordingArea`).
- Keys: **Enter starts the countdown**, R is an alias, **P / V switch Capture ↔ Record** in place (box and mode stay). "Use selection" is gone from the UI; main still accepts `select`.
- Screen card opened to record: "● Record this display", the mode row and Mic · System · Cam chips; the switch sits in its header.
- The screenshot action bar gains the same Capture | Record switch. Window mode stays behind its flag (NIW2-469).

**Countdown and recording**
- A take started from the overlay keeps the main window hidden. The recording shade window draws the countdown on the chosen region (2 px pink border, 40 % dim outside, the number, "Recording starts… press Esc to cancel"). Esc is a global shortcut held only during the countdown. The recorder reports its phase to main over `recording:recorder-phase`.
- While an area records, the shade **keeps its dark fill** (owner decision) and adds the design's 2 px pink border 3 px outside the area plus a "REC · BORDER NOT RECORDED" tag. A whole-display recording gets a 3 px pink border and no fill.
- The control bar sits outside the area (below it, else to the right, else to the left, else bottom centre) and shows a mono mode chip (16:9 / FRAME / WINDOW / SCREEN). The bar is now 480 DIP wide (was 430).

**Record page and tray**
- "Start recording", the `startRecording` shortcut and the Frame · Window · Screen chips open the selector (`recording:request-selector`) in the last used mode, or in the chip's mode, which then becomes the last used one. `AppSettings.recordingMode` (default `screen`) stores it.
- Window opens the thumbnail picker; picking a source then starts the countdown.
- Record page: eyebrow, "Ready to record", Start with its helper, LAST USED chips with a "16:9 · 1280 × 720" caption, SOUND & CAMERA, and Recent (the four newest recordings). The recording-state layout is unchanged.
- Tray Record tab: Start, compact chips, the inputs, and the "Last used: Frame · 16:9" footnote.
- The camera toggle is still rendered only through `RecordingToggles`. It is not renamed, so the camera PR #380's `cameraSlot` should rebase cleanly.

## Decisions against the spec (recorded in the spec's "Task 5 implementation notes")
- Decision 2: Enter = Record. R is an alias. Use selection is removed. A Capture | Record switch (P/V) is added and `intent` is mutable overlay state. Open question 3 is closed.
- Decision 4 is **kept**: dark outside, clear inside. The border and tag are drawn on top. New: the whole-display border, and the countdown drawn on the region. ADR 0030 is not amended.
- Decision 7 is amended: the control bar moves next to the area.
- Decision 8: the page and tray have no selection card. Start opens the selector, and `recordingMode` is now stored.
- Decision 9: `startRecording` opens the selector instead of starting the current target.
- New: aspect ratios. They are removed from "Out of scope".

## Deviations and open points
- **The switch is per overlay window.** With several displays, switching on one does not switch the others, because main does not broadcast the intent.
- **The Record page caption is in DIP, the overlay readout is in device pixels.** The remembered area stores DIP and no scale factor.
- **Recent thumbnails have no mode tag** ("FRAME · 16:9"): recordings do not store their mode. The page does show a duration badge.
- The page and tray inputs keep the existing `RecordingToggles` look. The design's full-width ON/OFF chips are not used, to keep the camera PR rebase cheap.
- **The overlay's camera bubble is a placeholder circle at the default 224 DIP size**, not a live feed.
- **No tray submenu** (spec task 5): the design file has none.
- **A window recording gets no border** (the window can move). Its countdown still shows in the main window (picker path).
- **The hint says "1–3"** only when Window is enabled. As shipped it reads "1–2".

## How to verify manually
1. Record page → **Start recording** (or the `startRecording` shortcut): the overlay opens in the last used mode, which is Screen on a fresh install.
2. Frame chip (or `recordArea`). Check:
   - the ratio bar, with the size doubling on a Retina display;
   - drag a corner with 16:9 locked: the ratio holds;
   - pick 9:16: the box reshapes around its centre;
   - the widget toggles change Mic / System / Camera everywhere;
   - turning the camera on shows the placeholder bottom-left.
3. Press **P**: the screenshot bar appears with the same box. Press **V**: back to the record chrome. Press **Enter**: the overlay closes and the countdown runs on the box, with the main window staying hidden.
4. During the countdown press **Esc**: it cancels, and the shade disappears.
5. Record an area. Check:
   - dark outside, with the pink border and the REC tag;
   - neither the border nor the tag is in the video;
   - clicks pass through to the apps;
   - the control bar sits below the area (or beside it, for a tall area) and shows "16:9";
   - the camera bubble sits inside the area.
6. Record a whole display: a 3 px pink border around it, no dim, the bar at bottom centre with "SCREEN".
7. Window chip: the thumbnail picker opens, and picking a window starts the countdown.
8. Reopen the Record page: LAST USED and the caption reflect the last take, and Recent lists it.

## Checks run
- `bun run test` (apps/kaipu-record): 273 files, 2430 tests passed.
- `bun run check-types` (node + web): clean.
- `bun run lint`: 0 errors. The 17 warnings are pre-existing, all in untouched files.
- `oxfmt --check`: clean.
- The pre-push `verify:local` passed.

## Not verified
- **Nothing was run in the real app.** No Electron launch, no real displays, no Windows build. All the behaviour above is covered only by unit and component tests (jsdom) and by type checks.
- Specifically unverified:
  - holding the global Esc shortcut during the countdown;
  - the shade's countdown → recording transition in a real window;
  - content protection of the new border;
  - control-bar placement on real work areas;
  - the camera placeholder against the real bubble position;
  - Retina device-pixel readouts.
